## Large Stingray (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 N Large animal (aquatic)  
 **Init** +0; **Senses** low-light vision, scent, tremorsense 100 ft.; Perception +11  

**Defense**

 **AC** 14, touch 9, flat-footed 14 (+5 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 68 (8d8+24 plus 8)  
 **Fort** +9, **Ref** +6, **Will** +3  

**Offense**

 **Speed** swim 30 ft.  
 **Melee** sting +11 (1d8+6 plus poison), wing +9 (1d6+3)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** poison  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 22, **Dex** 11, **Con** 17, **Int** 1, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 2  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +13; **CMD** 23 (can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** Ability Focus (poison), Multiattack, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness  
 **Skills** Perception +11, Stealth +3, Swim +14  

**Special Abilities**

 **Poison (Ex)** Sting—injury; *save* Fort DC 19; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d2 Str and paralysis 1d6+2 rds.; *cure* 1 save.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** warm aquatic  
 **Organization** solitary or school (2–5)  
 **Treasure** none
